items.label: Refresh LiveSticky
items.description: Clears cached data, re-fetches profile images, updates the dashboard, and runs an immediate status check.

enableDashboard.label: ⚙️ Custom Post Dashboard
enableDashboard.helpText: Powers a persistent interactive dashboard post.

dashboardHeight.label: ⚙️ Dashboard Post Height
dashboardHeight.helpText: Select the height of your interactive dashboard post. Compact (320px) keeps the post extra tight on community feeds. Tall (512px) provides extra visual room.

updateSidebarWidget.label: ⚙️ Sidebar Widget
updateSidebarWidget.helpText: Creates and automatically updates a "Stream Status" text widget in your community sidebar.

stickyOfflinePost.label: ⚙️ Offline Post
stickyOfflinePost.helpText: Recycles a single permanent pinned post when offline to announce news and useful links. The post is unpinned when live and pinned again when offline. Because it is recycled, users are never notified of a new post after creation.

enableLivePost.label: ⚙️ Live Post
enableLivePost.helpText: Automatically creates and pins a standard text post when the stream goes live.

removeOfflinePost.label: ⚙️ Hide Live Post from Feed when Offline
removeOfflinePost.helpText: Mod action: Hides the live post from the community feed when offline. It remains accessible via direct links or comment histories without cluttering the feed.

deleteOfflinePost.label: ⚙️ Delete Live Post when Offline
deleteOfflinePost.helpText: Deletes the live post and all its comments when the stream ends.

lockLivePostWhenOffline.label: ⚙️ Lock Live Thread when Offline
lockLivePostWhenOffline.helpText: Locks the live post comments when the stream ends so no new comments can be added.

offlineGracePeriod.label: ⚙️ Disconnect Grace Period (Minutes)
offlineGracePeriod.helpText: Minutes to wait before concluding the live post (prevents duplicates during crashes).

enableHighlightsPost.label: ⚙️ Stream Highlights Post
enableHighlightsPost.helpText: Automatically posts a compilation of top Twitch clips generated during the stream when it ends.

enableDynamicFlair.label: 💊 Dynamic Post Flair Updates
enableDynamicFlair.helpText: Periodically updates the live post (or dashboard post) flair with active game and live viewers (e.g. 🔴 LIVE: Just Chatting [15.4K]).

offlineUserFlairText.label: 💊 Offline User Flair Text
offlineUserFlairText.helpText: Assigned to the streamer's user flair when offline.

liveUserFlairText.label: 💊 Live User Flair Text
liveUserFlairText.helpText: Assigned to the streamer's user flair when live.

liveFlairId.label: 💊 Live Post Flair Template ID
liveFlairId.helpText: The UUID of the flair template to apply to the live post (from Mod Tools ➔ Look and Feel ➔ Post Flair).

highlightsFlairId.label: 💊 Highlights Post Flair Template ID
highlightsFlairId.helpText: The UUID of the flair template to apply to the stream highlights post (from Mod Tools ➔ Look and Feel ➔ Post Flair).

primaryPlatform.label: 👑 Primary Platform
primaryPlatform.helpText: This platform will always appear at the top of the multistream dashboard.

customAvatarUrl.label: 👑 Avatar Image URL
customAvatarUrl.helpText: Override your profile picture with a DIRECT Reddit image link (i.redd.it/…). Upload an image to Reddit, then copy its direct link. Leave blank to auto-fetch from your primary platform.

setupReference.label: 📖 Platform API Setup Guide
setupReference.helpText: Follow the step-by-step guide to generate API credentials for the platforms below: https://livesticky.com/setup

templatesReference.label: 📖 Templates & Placeholders Reference
templatesReference.helpText: Copy and paste templates for the text fields below from the LiveSticky website: https://livesticky.com/customization

offlinePostTitle.label: 😴 Offline Post Title
offlinePostTitle.helpText: Title for the offline post. If empty, the default template is used.

offlinePostBody.label: 😴 Offline Post Body
offlinePostBody.helpText: Body for the offline post. If empty, the default template is used.
offlinePostBody.defaultValue:
The stream is currently offline. Check back soon or follow the channels below to get notified when {stream_display_name} goes live!

---
**Watch the VODs on:**

🟪 **[Twitch]({twitch_url})**  •  🟥 **[YouTube]({youtube_url})**  •  🟩 **[Kick]({kick_url})**

offlinePostFooter.label: 😴 Offline Post Footer Text
offlinePostFooter.helpText: Optional. Appended to the bottom of the offline post.

offlineSidebarText.label: 😴 Offline Sidebar Widget Text
offlineSidebarText.helpText: Body for the offline sidebar widget. If empty, the default template is used.
offlineSidebarText.defaultValue:

Follow the channels below to get notified when {stream_display_name} goes live!

---
**Watch the VODs on:**

offlineSidebarFooter.label: 😴 Offline Sidebar Widget Footer Text
offlineSidebarFooter.helpText: Optional. Appended to the bottom of the offline sidebar widget.

livePostTitle.label: 🔴 Live Post Title
livePostTitle.helpText: Title for the live post. If empty, the default template is used.

livePostBody.label: 🔴 Live Post Body
livePostBody.helpText: Body for the live post. If empty, the default template is used.

livePostFooter.label: 🔴 Live Post Footer Text
livePostFooter.helpText: Optional. Appended to the bottom of the live post.

liveCommentText.label: 🔴 Auto-Pinned Comment Text
liveCommentText.helpText: Optional. Automatically posts and pins a mod comment inside the live post.

liveSidebarText.label: 🔴 Live Sidebar Widget Text
liveSidebarText.helpText: Body for the live sidebar widget. If empty, the default template is used.

liveSidebarFooter.label: 🔴 Live Sidebar Widget Footer Text
liveSidebarFooter.helpText: Optional. Appended to the bottom of the live sidebar widget.

concludingPostBody.label: 🎬 Concluding Post Body
concludingPostBody.helpText: Body for the concluding post. If empty, the default template is used.

concludingPostFooter.label: 🎬 Concluding Post Footer Text
concludingPostFooter.helpText: Optional. Appended to the bottom of the concluding post.

highlightsPostTitle.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Title
highlightsPostTitle.helpText: Title for the stream highlights post. If empty, the default template is used.

highlightsHeader.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Header Text
highlightsHeader.helpText: Header for the stream highlights post. If empty, the default template is used.

highlightsFooter.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Footer Text
highlightsFooter.helpText: Appended to the bottom of the stream highlights post. If empty, the default template is used.
highlightsFooter.defaultValue:

modNotes.label: 📝 Internal Moderator Notes
modNotes.helpText: Use this space as a scratchpad for your mod team to document API key owners, custom flair IDs, or temporary configuration changes. LiveSticky ignores this field.
modNotes.placeholder: e.g. "Twitch API keys belong to u/ModName"
